title: Myths & Monsters: The Forgotten Folklore of Charleston
includes: Hear the truth about America's 1st female serial killer and the reality of the Doctor of the Dead.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
For 60 minutes, you will be led through the ancient streets of Historic 
Charleston, hearing the city's oldest myths & monster legends from master storytellers. From Native American spirits and Gullah folklore monsters to sea creatures and real life Dr. Frankensteins, you will find that there is much lurking in the shadows of the Holy City.
